title: tehas panel --json
description: The object tehas panel --json prints, version 1, the same one state/panels.json and live/panels.json hold. host/docs/api.md says what each field means and what the command refuses. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the samples beside this file against it.
